頒.meaning: The giant <part>rubber duck</part> balloon at the town parade pops, so the mayor cuts it into a thousand pieces. She stands on the town hall steps and gives one <part>part</part> to every child: a yellow scrap, a wing, a bit of beak. She loves to <kanji>hand out</kanji> souvenirs.
頒.on: Every scrap comes with a spoonful of <sound>hon</sound>ey.
頒.kun: The last scrap goes to a crying toddler, and his '<sound>Wah</sound>!' turns into a giggle.

滋.meaning: Grandma's <part>sewing kit</part> holds no needles, only dried herbs, beans and barley on little spools. She shakes some into a pan, adds <part>water drops</part> from the tap, and simmers it all day. One mug of it mends a cold better than any medicine: truly <kanji>nourishing</kanji>.
滋.on: Her grandson drinks it in his muddy <sound>jee</sound>p before driving home.

罷.meaning: A circus bear can juggle, ride a unicycle and sing: every <part>ability</part> in the book. One night the safety <part>net</part> under her tightrope is missing, so she folds her arms, hangs up her hat and walks out of the tent. She has <kanji>quit</kanji>.
罷.on: She clicks out of the big top, a tall red <sound>hee</sound>l on each foot.
罷.kun: She tells her <sound>ma</sound>ma to stay <sound>ca</sound>lm: she'll find a better circus.

鶴.meaning: A tall white <part>bird</part> moves into a little <part>birdhouse</part> on a post, but only her body fits. Her long legs dangle out of the bottom, her neck pokes out of the chimney, and she sleeps standing on one foot anyway. Too tall for any house: a <kanji>crane</kanji>.
鶴.on: In the morning she finds a fish <sound>carc</sound>ass on her roof, left by a cheeky gull.
鶴.kun: '<sound>Tsu</sound>!' she sneezes at the smell, and a <sound>roo</sound>k on the next post says bless you.

謄.meaning: An emperor who always speaks in the <part>imperial we</part> ('We are pleased...') feeds his <part>speech</part> into a clattering old machine. It cranks out a thousand smudgy purple sheets that smell of ink, one for every village. That's a <kanji>mimeograph</kanji>.
謄.on: One damp sheet sticks to his big <sound>toe</sound> as he walks away.

錮.meaning: A greedy dragon sleeps on her pile of <part>gold</part> for so long that the coins <part>harden</part> around her like a plaster cast. She can blink, but she can't move a claw. Locked inside her own treasure: total <kanji>confinement</kanji>.
錮.on: A <sound>ko</sound>ala climbs in through the window and pinches one coin a day.
錮.kun: Her <sound>foo</sound>t is stuck, and a tin of <sound>sa</sound>rdines sits just out of reach: all blocked up.

氾.meaning: A clumsy office worker knocks over her water glass. As the <part>water drops</part> race across the desk, she slams her inky rubber <part>stamp</part> down to stop them. Now blue water creeps over every form, off the desk and across the carpet. The puddle has <kanji>spread out</kanji> over the whole office.
氾.on: Even the jar of <sound>hon</sound>ey on the shelf is bobbing along in it.
氾.kun: She hops onto her chair in her <sound>hee</sound>ls and orders the stain to stop, but it's a <sound>ro</sound>tten listener.

濫.meaning: A lifeguard is meant to <part>oversee</part> the hotel pool but dozes off in her tall chair. Someone leaves the hose running, the <part>water drops</part> become a flood, and the pool spills over the lobby and out into the street. Far too much water: <kanji>excessive</kanji>.
濫.on: Next door, the planes on the airport <sound>run</sound>way float like ducks.
濫.kun: A <sound>mee</sound>rkat paddles through the lobby on a lilo and sings 'Ta-<sound>da</sound>!' for no reason at all: recklessly.

塑.meaning: A badger who can't sleep pushes up wet <part>soil</part> at night and pats it into shapes. By dawn there's a clay garden on the lawn: a rose, a tulip, and a <part>moonflower</part> with its petals open wide. The gardener gasps: every bloom is a perfect <kanji>model</kanji>.
塑.on: The badger sits back on a lumpy mud <sound>so</sound>fa to admire his work.
塑.kun: The gardener carries the clay flowers out to her <sound>deck</sound> and props a little clay badger among them like a puppet.
